What is the main difference between the Dickey Fuller (DF) and Phillips-Perron (PP) approaches to unit root testing?
Option A: ADF is a single equation approach to unit root testing while PP is a systems approach
Option B: PP tests reverse the DF null and alternative hypotheses so that there is stationarity under the null hypothesis of the PP test
Option C: The PP test incorporates an automatic correction for autocorrelated residuals in the test regression
Option D: PP tests have good power in small samples whereas DF tests do not.
